title: Leave the previous record intact after interrupted file publication
preconditions: Use a temporary record.json containing old newline and store faultHook that fails before-commit.

steps.action: Attempt to replace record.json with new newline using WriteFile.
steps.expected_result: The write returns an error; original bytes remain old newline; the directory contains only record.json and no temporary files.

expected_result: A failed single-file publication exposes no partial replacement.
